steps.question: Lesson 7: 88 vs Two All-Ins. What is your best action?

gradingSpecJson.responseIncorrect: There is a better line in this node.
gradingSpecJson.followUpContent: 88 vs two all-ins. Likely up against overpairs or bigger pairs; you're dominated. Calling 35k into the side pot is -EV. Folding is correct—don't put more in when you're crushed. Core lesson: Pocket pairs are easily dominated by bigger pairs. When multiple players are all-in, the chance you're beat is high—don't put more money in when you're likely crushed. Save your stack for spots where you have real equity.
